title: RDM: Add packets for E1.37-4 FTC
description:
Add new packet definitions for the new standards document.

Specification available here: [https://tsp.esta.org/tsp/documents/published_docs.php](https://tsp.esta.org/tsp/documents/published_docs.php#:~:text=ANSI%20E1.37-4%20-%202026)

As the standard is quite new there aren't really any implementations to test with yet, but I have made a capture with one example from the spec to check the CRC16 calculation as it's a bit awkward.

[RDM_FTC_single.pcapng](/uploads/f3a4c04c18e9e653801ac9dbe93e7f64/RDM_FTC_single.pcapng)
